name: dogfood-security-mtls-zero-trust-app
description: Dogfood app v1.39-2 — an Istio + OPA style mutual-TLS + Zero-trust access broker (mTLS handshake + SPKI certificate pinning + OCSP stapling + Certificate Transparency log + device posture evaluation + risk scoring + Just-in-Time access + micro-segmentation) that drives an mTLS + Zero-trust surface backed by @kiwa-lab/security v0.2 mtls + zero-trust semantics, runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (KIWA_MTLS_CA_PATH + KIWA_ISTIO_URL + KIWA_OPA_URL provider endpoints) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory state machine) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/security @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --hookTimeout 30000
